changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: preference_notification : clé id UUID, unicité sur utilisateur_id.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.preference_notification ADD COLUMN id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7()
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.preference_notification ALTER COLUMN id DROP DEFAULT
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.preference_notification ADD CONSTRAINT pk_preference_notification PRIMARY KEY (id)
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.preference_notification ADD CONSTRAINT uk_preference_notification_utilisateur_id UNIQUE (utilisateur_id)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.preference_notification ADD CONSTRAINT pk_preference_notification PRIMARY KEY (utilisateur_id)

changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: journal_audit_scellement : clé id UUID v7 à la place de l'identité bigint.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement ADD COLUMN id_uuid uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT ${database.defaultSchemaName}.uuid_v7()
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement RENAME COLUMN id_uuid TO id
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement ADD CONSTRAINT pk_journal_audit_scellement PRIMARY KEY (id)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement ADD COLUMN id_seq bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement RENAME COLUMN id_seq TO id
ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.journal_audit_scellement ADD CONSTRAINT pk_journal_audit_scellement PRIMARY KEY (id)
